text:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the late-night PM. We have a short remediation list but need explicit owners + dates. Main failure modes were quota exhaustion during batch window and scheduler packing/preemption misfires. Who's taking which item?

anita: I can take the temporary reserve pool plan. Proposal: enable a labeled emergency pool of 16 GPUs (billing tag: emergency_autoscale) to kick in when node_free_gpus < 8 for >10m. Target enable: 2026-04-03.

maria: I'll own the scheduler changes. Plan is a staged canary then global roll. Tests: add prioritization lanes for short jobs, reduce packing_window, and set eviction_budget. I'll open PR today. Target PR: 2026-04-02; rollout by 2026-04-06 if green.

samir: I'll own recurring-pattern instrumentation. I'm adding two signatures to the postmortem: "batch-peak-starvation" and "long-run-allocation-leak". Will add log queries and a weekly dashboard. Start: 2026-04-04.

kevin: Filed quota escalation ticket Q-5179 to cloud-provider (link: https://tickets.example.com/Q-5179). Marked urgent. ETA per provider: 2-5 business days. Contingency: enable anita's reserve pool after 48h if not approved.

lisa: Headroom calc snapshot (last 72h):
```
max_concurrent_jobs: 48
peak_gpu_usage: 94
cluster_capacity_total: 112
operational_headroom(10%): 11
observed_allocation_variance: 7%
```

lisa: Recommendation: bump autoscale target by +12 GPUs and add a smoothing window of 3m. Draft doc: https://docs.example.com/headroom/gpu-v2

maria: Scheduler tuning knobs I intend to test:
```
- packing_window_ms: 250 -> 140
- eviction_budget: 0.12 (12%)
- preempt_policy: staggered -> immediate on high-prio
- short_job_lane: jobs < 90s get dedicated slot
```

maria: Will include rollback steps and dashboard links in PR.

jordan: Good. Also add an explicit alert: pager if node_free_gpus < 6 for 15m AND pod_evictions > 5 in 10m. We need human attention before cascading.

ops-bot: alert: node_free_gpus < 6 in prod-us-west-2 (15m). Notifying oncall.

kevin: A note on quota requests: provider asked for workload justification. I attached the postmortem and added commit history showing burst patterns. They asked for billing contact; I've added finance alias.

anita: Reserve pool will be gated by a feature flag and labeled in billing. I'll add playbook steps to flip it and a TTL auto-disable after 72h.

samir: I've added queries to the postmortem doc and a link to the recurring-incidents board. Invite sent to ops-sre and platform-eng for weekly triage (Mon 09:00).

maria: PR opened: https://git.example.com/redwood/scheduler/pulls/341 (canary -> cluster-b). Smoke passing.

lisa: Headroom doc updated with simulator results and cost delta. Link: https://docs.example.com/headroom/gpu-v2#sim

jordan: Great. Please drop a one-line status update here when each ticket/PR is created (ticket number or PR link + eta). I'll close the loop once the remediation board has all items tracked. Next sync: 2026-04-05 09:00.

kevin: Q-5179 created and escalated. Noted contingency.

anita: Reserve pool feature flag created: FF-reserve-pool-2026. Ready behind flag, but not enabled.

maria: PR link posted above. Canary started at 02:30 UTC.

samir: Recurring patterns dashboard scheduled.

ops-bot: reminder: weekly-triage meeting scheduled (Mon 09:00).

jordan: Thanks all. Keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
